6. Discuss trends and impacts.
7. Propose mitigative measures.

### Start with the Monitoring Records

Before drafting the report, compile all relevant monitoring data from:
- Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (CEMS)
- Periodic source testing results
- Ambient air quality monitoring data
- Stack testing data
- Maintenance and inspection logs

Gather all available data on the frequency, duration, and magnitude of emissions, including details such as the types of pollutants and their respective concentrations. 

### Determine the Applicable Regulations

Understand and document the local, regional, and national air quality regulations that apply to the industrial facility. This includes:
- Emission limits for various pollutants
- Compliance requirements
- Reporting standards

The report should explicitly state which regulatory limits have been exceeded.
